import axios from"axios";const API_BASE_URL=process.env.REACT_APP_API_URL||"http://localhost:8080/api";const api=axios.create({baseURL:API_BASE_URL,headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"}});// Attach JWT token to requests if available
